trello.name: Add queue depth alerts for worker fleet
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Add queue depth alerting across the entire worker fleet (not just payments), with consistent thresholds: warning at 1,000 jobs, page at 5,000 jobs.

trello.name: Fix payment worker retry logic
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Fix the retry logic in payment_worker.py (_process_with_retry function). Implement exponential backoff with jitter, cap the number of retries, and on final failure send jobs to a dead-letter queue at the back rather than re-enqueuing at the front of the main queue. Add tests simulating processor 503 responses to cover this behavior.

trello.name: Bump and split DB connection pools
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. In one config change: bump the DB connection pool from the default 20 to 100, and split the worker and API connection pools so they no longer share. Same config file, both parts in one change.

trello.name: Update payment incident runbook
trello.desc: Owner: Priya (Kofi to confirm with her after the meeting). Update the payment incident runbook: replace old Kibana links (turned off in March) with current logging links, document the queue drain procedure improvised during Tuesday's outage, and verify escalation phone numbers are current (one reportedly still routes to someone who left last year).

trello.name: Automate status page updates
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Automate the status page so that when the checkout error rate alert fires, the status page automatically flips to 'investigating' with a template message. Wire it to the checkout alert first; can be extended to other alerts later. The status provider has an API.

trello.name: Draft payment processor failover game day plan
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Draft a controlled chaos game day plan to test the secondary payment processor failover, starting in staging then production during a low-traffic window, with a rollback plan. Plan to be reviewed in two weeks before any execution. No execution until the review. Kofi leads and drafts the plan.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis from EOL 6.0 to 7.2
trello.desc: Owner: Kofi. Upgrade Redis from 6.0 (security fixes ended in June) to 7.2. Account for a config rename and changed persistence defaults. Schedule a proper change window via the infra calendar (not a casual Friday deploy).

trello.name: Write and send outage timeline doc
trello.desc: Owner: Ines. Write up the postmortem timeline document tonight and send it out tomorrow.

trello.name: Post team lunch details to channel
trello.desc: Owner: Marta. Post the Thursday team lunch (Thai place) details to the channel, including headcount request. Already in progress.
